subject.title: fix(ai): add handshake timeout to ChatGPT Responses WebSocket connect

question: Should an explicit options.timeoutMs value above 30 seconds be allowed to govern the ChatGPT Responses WebSocket handshake, or should this provider intentionally impose a non-configurable 30-second maximum?
rationale: The branch changes an existing provider timeout contract for configured users; the correct behavior is a product and compatibility choice rather than a mechanical cleanup.

options.title: Preserve explicit timeout budgets
options.body: Use the existing caller-selected timeout when present and apply the 30-second handshake deadline only as the default for otherwise unbounded connects.

options.title: Adopt a fixed provider cap
options.body: Keep the independent 30-second cap, document it as an intentional provider policy, and add upgrade coverage proving the resulting fallback behavior.

recommendation.title: Preserve explicit timeout budgets
recommendation.body: Use the existing caller-selected timeout when present and apply the 30-second handshake deadline only as the default for otherwise unbounded connects.
